what: Over the hero photo, four vertical bands in 20% of the background color sit side by side. After window load they fold one by one from the left at .12s intervals, pivoting on the top right (scaleX 0), and clear over .9s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1). The blurred photo sharpens column by column.

options.dur: Duration for one band to clear (sec), default .9
options.on: load (default — after window load) or scroll (once when visible)
options.--fx-shine: Band color (via style), default background color 20%
options.--fx-origin: Axis the strip folds on (via style), default right top — as in the original. With left center it folds to the left

from.where: shared.css .jb-shine (original .cm-imgwrap — ::before·::after·inner ::before·::after width 25% rgba(255,255,255,.2), transform .9s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)·transform-origin top right, scale(0,1) on is-load, delays 0·.12·.24·.36s) — header photos of the Hero and lower sections
